answer: Vote weight is river that flows outward from a few founding seats along signed threads, and each thread carries at most 1 river per epoch, so a vertex never holds more river than its incoming threads deliver. Clones can thread to each other freely, but that creates nothing new: n clones behind 2 threads from honest vertices share 2 river. To give 30 clones the weight of 30 honest agents, one operator needs 30 threads from honest vertices, each of which signs only a few, so every extra clone means bribing another unrelated agent.
